---
title: "Apps for working with data from the Homer Multitext project"
---

You can download these apps and use them on your own computer, or use these installations on github pages:


- [*Iliad* + *scholia* reader](./iliad-scholia.html): select passage of the *Iliad* and view any *scholia* on the selected lines
- [Facsimile reader](./va-facsimile.html): browse page images of the Venetus A, hover over indexed page to see textual edition
- [Interwoven diplomatic/normalized reader](./editorial.html): read *Iliad* and *scholia* texts in diplomatic transcription with editorial normalizations in parentheses.

::: {.callout-note}
## Versions
Each app displays an individual version number. Github release versions refer to release versions of the entire repository.

For details of both github releases and individual app versions, see the [release notes](https://github.com/neelsmith/hmt-apps/blob/main/releases.md).


:::
